text: Sarah O'Neill and her shy son Chris [move to the Irish countryside|trigger|making a new home], where a large sinkhole lies hidden in the forest. A local woman, Noreen, once believed her own son was not her son, and she screams the same thing about Chris; at her funeral [every mirror in the house is covered|images|mirrors and glass]. After a night when Chris vanishes and reappears in his doorway, he begins to change, eating food he used to hate and [catching and eating a spider|images|vermin and creeping things], and Sarah becomes convinced [the boy is not her son|threat|impostors and doubles].
